name: TOB TTS Audio Cache
description: One synthesized audio clip, cached by a hash of (text, locale, voice_type, audio_encoding) — mirrors TOB Content Translation's own 'hash arbitrary source text, never write back to the source' pattern. Replaying the same verse/article/blog paragraph in the same language and voice tier never re-pays the TTS vendor; api/tts.py checks this table before calling out.

fields.label: Cache Key
fields.description: sha256 of text+locale+voice_type+audio_encoding — a voice-tier or encoding change never silently serves a stale-sounding clip.

fields.label: Locale
fields.description: The BCP-47 locale sent to the vendor, e.g. 'ta-IN'.

fields.label: Voice Type
fields.description: The voice tier active at synthesis time (from TOB TTS Provider.voice_type when this row was created).

fields.label: Hit Count
fields.description: Not read by any logic yet — kept for a future cache-eviction/popularity report.

fields.label: Source Text
fields.description: Kept for admin debugging/QA only — not read by any runtime logic.
